text:
Aisha Patel: Heads-up — we've published a small ratecard patch (v2.4.1). Effective next Monday. See quick summary below and tag if you need edits to quoting templates.

Ben Liu: link? where do I point sellers?

Aisha Patel: https://internal.redwood/ratecards/v2.4.1 (public to sales). TL;DR: added a temporary SKU `dedicated-burst` for predictable burst capacity, small token price bump for `embed-large` models (+3%), and clarified commit crediting for hybrid billing. No changes to enterprise commit tiers.

Sofia Martinez: do we have grandfathering for ongoing POCs?

Aisha Patel: yes — all active POCs with start_date <= 2026-04-10 are grandfathered to v2.4.0 pricing for 90 days. Added a note in the change log.

Tom Reed: legal flagged the new `dedicated-burst` SKU — wants explicit language about billing cadence. Can someone drop a recommended clause?

Ben Liu: @Tom Reed I'll prep a one-paragraph addendum for deal desk templates. Also: sales play to highlight that `dedicated-burst` is for short-term throughput surges and is billed hourly on top of reserved capacity.

ratecard-bot: v2.4.1 changelog generated by @pricing-team at 2026-03-21T14:12Z — file: /assets/ratecards/changelog-2.4.1.md :page_facing_up:

Sofia Martinez: quick question — does the +3% embed-large increase affect credits/commits?

Aisha Patel: it affects unit price but commit calculations remain based on normalized token units. We updated the commit calculator; please advise sellers to re-run the estimator for >$50k ARR deals.

Ben Liu: FYI I'm pushing an update to the quoting template (Google Sheets) with new SKUs and a note about POC grandfathering. ETA EOD today.

Tom Reed: thanks — I'll add a short clause for billing cadence and refund rules for bursts. Share draft here when ready.

Sofia Martinez: can we get a one-line summary for customer-facing comms? Sales ops prefers a 1-2 sentence blurb.

Aisha Patel: suggested line: "Minor ratecard update: new short-term burst SKU for predictable throughput, small adjustment to embed pricing. Active POCs started before 2026-04-10 are unaffected for 90 days."

Ben Liu: that works. Adding to the template and to the enablement slack thread. :thumbsup:

ratecard-bot: reminder scheduled: send enablement note to #sales-enable and update the public ratecard page on 2026-03-22 09:00Z.

Aisha Patel: thanks everyone — ping me if you see any regressions in quoting calc.

Sofia Martinez: noted. will retest the estimator with two open deals and report back.

Ben Liu: closing loop — template updated and shared in #sales-enable.

Tom Reed: posted legal clause in thread: "Burst charges billed hourly; refunds prorated for system outages > 4 hours; disputes to be escalated to Revenue Ops."

Aisha Patel: perfect, closing out. :white_check_mark:
